verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical. Both make the $49.99 price huge but shrink 'for all drinkware on' to a tiny three-line stack. Both keep the URL vertical at microscopic size, so it can't be read. Both push the product list against the right edge, leave a large dead gap in the middle, and lose the original's white card and full-height colour stripes. Those are reduced to a small grey and blue/red sliver on the left. The only visible difference is that B's left stripe block runs a few pixels taller, which doesn't matter.
